reading: Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq stock exchange on Thursday against a backdrop of enormous spending on artificial intelligence (AI).
The company reached a market value of roughly $1.76 trillion, placing it among the world's most valuable publicly traded businesses.
As the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, Anthropic created a test for the wider industry.
Its shares initially climbed to $111.53 before retreating to close at $97.17.
The shares moved above their $83 allocation price, the price set for their initial distribution to investors, signalling considerable enthusiasm for AI.
The broader Nasdaq Composite Index, however, closed nearly 2.3% lower.
Nevertheless, Anthropic, the company behind Claude, faces intense scrutiny over whether AI will justify the resources devoted to it.
A handful of major technology companies collectively spent more than $1 trillion on the AI buildout in the previous year alone.
The pace of this spending has fuelled fears that prices may be inflated by excessive optimism.
Economist Richard Whittle cautioned that bubbles burst when confidence in a positive future weakens, rather than necessarily on the day of a major deal.
Ben Barringer, who leads technology research at Quilter Cheviot, expects substantial fluctuations in Anthropic's share price.
Barringer warned that the initial exuberance, or unusually strong enthusiasm, would wear off.
Investor strategist Neil Wilson said that Anthropic lacks an obvious peer against which its worth can be assessed.
New laws governing AI tools are also a possibility.
Some US politicians have indicated that they want AI tools to be safe and subject to guardrails, meaning limits intended to prevent harmful use.
Donald Trump reiterated his opposition to robust regulation of AI, indicating resistance to substantial rules governing the technology.
A bipartisan group of US lawmakers nevertheless formed a caucus, a group organised around a shared policy interest, to address AI regulation and safety.
Anthropic executives, including co-founder Dario Amodei, have been outspoken in expressing fears that future AI could outsmart humans and potentially threaten humanity's survival.
Despite having described its rapidly developing technology as potentially dangerous, Anthropic has made an exceptionally swift transition from start-up to public listing.

vocabulary.definition: Stated a view or position again, often for emphasis; used especially in formal reporting.
Close, sustained examination that subjects claims or decisions to demanding questions.
Strong, energetic enthusiasm that, in financial reporting, can suggest optimism exceeding what the evidence warrants.
To gradually lose strength or intensity, especially when an initial feeling or effect fades.
A sufficiently similar company that can provide a useful basis for assessing another company's performance or worth.
Changes in a price, amount or level as it moves up and down rather than steadily in one direction.
Rules or limits intended to prevent harmful behaviour while allowing an activity to continue.
Strong, substantial rules intended to exercise meaningful control over an activity or industry.
Involving members of two political parties, indicating cooperation across a party divide.
Expressing views publicly and directly, including views that may attract disagreement.

entries.ja: 見解や立場を、しばしば強調のために改めて述べた。特に改まった報道で使われる表現。
entries.ko: 견해나 입장을 다시 밝혔다. 흔히 강조하기 위한 것이며, 특히 격식을 갖춘 보도에서 쓰이는 표현이다.
entries.zh-Hans: 再次表明了某种观点或立场，往往是为了加以强调；尤其常用于正式报道。
entries.es: Volvió a expresar una opinión o postura, a menudo para darle énfasis; se usa especialmente en la información periodística formal.
entries.pt-BR: Voltou a expressar uma opinião ou posição, muitas vezes para dar ênfase; expressão usada especialmente em textos jornalísticos formais.
entries.fr: A exprimé de nouveau un avis ou une position, souvent pour insister ; expression employée surtout dans les comptes rendus formels.
entries.de: Äußerte eine Ansicht oder Position erneut, häufig zur Betonung; der Ausdruck wird besonders in der formellen Berichterstattung verwendet.

entries.ja: 主張や決定に厳しい問いを投げかけながら、綿密かつ継続的に検証すること。
entries.ko: 주장이나 결정에 대해 엄격한 질문을 제기하며 면밀하고 지속적으로 검토하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 持续而细致的审查，对各种主张或决定提出严格的质疑。
entries.es: Examen minucioso y continuo que somete afirmaciones o decisiones a preguntas exigentes.
entries.pt-BR: Análise minuciosa e contínua que submete afirmações ou decisões a questionamentos rigorosos.
entries.fr: Examen attentif et prolongé qui soumet des affirmations ou des décisions à des questions exigeantes.
entries.de: Eine genaue, anhaltende Prüfung, bei der Aussagen oder Entscheidungen kritisch hinterfragt werden.

entries.ja: 勢いのある強い熱意。金融報道では、根拠から見て妥当な範囲を超えた楽観を示唆することがある。
entries.ko: 활기차고 강한 열의. 금융 보도에서는 근거가 뒷받침하는 수준을 넘어선 낙관을 시사할 수 있다.
entries.zh-Hans: 强烈而充满活力的热情；在财经报道中，可能暗示乐观程度超出了现有证据所能支持的范围。
entries.es: Entusiasmo intenso y lleno de energía que, en la información financiera, puede sugerir un optimismo mayor del que justifican las pruebas disponibles.
entries.pt-BR: Entusiasmo intenso e cheio de energia que, no noticiário financeiro, pode sugerir um otimismo maior do que as evidências justificam.
entries.fr: Enthousiasme intense et débordant d’énergie qui, dans l’information financière, peut suggérer un optimisme supérieur à ce que les éléments disponibles justifient.
entries.de: Starke, lebhafte Begeisterung, die in der Finanzberichterstattung auf einen Optimismus hindeuten kann, der über das durch die Fakten gerechtfertigte Maß hinausgeht.

entries.ja: 強さや激しさが徐々に弱まること。特に、初めの気持ちや効果が薄れていく場合に使う。
entries.ko: 강도나 세기가 점차 약해지는 것. 특히 처음의 감정이나 효과가 서서히 사라질 때 쓰인다.
entries.zh-Hans: 强度或程度逐渐减弱，尤其指最初的感受或效果慢慢消退。
entries.es: Perder fuerza o intensidad de forma gradual, especialmente cuando una sensación o un efecto inicial se va desvaneciendo.
entries.pt-BR: Perder força ou intensidade aos poucos, especialmente quando um sentimento ou efeito inicial vai diminuindo.
entries.fr: Perdre progressivement de sa force ou de son intensité, notamment lorsqu’un sentiment ou un effet initial s’estompe.
entries.de: Allmählich an Stärke oder Intensität verlieren, besonders wenn ein anfängliches Gefühl oder eine anfängliche Wirkung nachlässt.

entries.ja: 他の企業の業績や価値を評価する際に、有用な比較基準となるほど十分に似ている企業。
entries.ko: 다른 기업의 실적이나 가치를 평가할 때 유용한 비교 기준이 될 만큼 충분히 비슷한 기업.
entries.zh-Hans: 与另一家公司足够相似，因而能为评估该公司的业绩或价值提供有用比较依据的公司。
entries.es: Empresa lo bastante similar a otra como para ofrecer una base útil para evaluar su rendimiento o valor.
entries.pt-BR: Empresa suficientemente semelhante a outra para servir como uma base útil de comparação ao avaliar seu desempenho ou valor.
entries.fr: Entreprise suffisamment semblable à une autre pour fournir une base utile à l’évaluation des performances ou de la valeur de celle-ci.
entries.de: Ein Unternehmen, das einem anderen ähnlich genug ist, um eine nützliche Vergleichsgrundlage für die Bewertung seiner Leistung oder seines Werts zu bieten.

entries.ja: 価格、数量、水準が一方向に安定して動くのではなく、上がったり下がったりする変動。
entries.ko: 가격, 양 또는 수준이 한 방향으로 꾸준히 움직이는 대신 오르내리면서 생기는 변화.
entries.zh-Hans: 价格、数量或水平上下起伏的变化，而不是持续朝同一方向变动。
entries.es: Cambios en un precio, una cantidad o un nivel que sube y baja en vez de avanzar de forma constante en una sola dirección.
entries.pt-BR: Mudanças em um preço, uma quantidade ou um nível que sobe e desce, em vez de seguir de forma constante em uma única direção.
entries.fr: Variations d’un prix, d’une quantité ou d’un niveau qui monte et descend au lieu d’évoluer régulièrement dans une seule direction.
entries.de: Veränderungen eines Preises, einer Menge oder eines Niveaus durch Auf- und Abbewegungen statt einer stetigen Entwicklung in eine Richtung.

entries.ja: 活動の継続を認めながら、有害な行動を防ぐことを目的とした規則や制限。
entries.ko: 활동은 계속할 수 있도록 하면서 해로운 행동을 막기 위해 마련한 규칙이나 제한.
entries.zh-Hans: 旨在防止有害行为，同时允许某项活动继续进行的规则或限制。
entries.es: Reglas o límites destinados a prevenir conductas perjudiciales y permitir al mismo tiempo que una actividad continúe.
entries.pt-BR: Regras ou limites destinados a evitar comportamentos prejudiciais, permitindo ao mesmo tempo que uma atividade continue.
entries.fr: Règles ou limites destinées à prévenir les comportements nuisibles tout en permettant à une activité de se poursuivre.
entries.de: Regeln oder Grenzen, die schädliches Verhalten verhindern sollen und zugleich die Fortsetzung einer Tätigkeit ermöglichen.

entries.ja: 活動や産業を実効性のある形で管理することを目的とした、強力で十分な内容を備えた規則。
entries.ko: 활동이나 산업을 실질적으로 통제하기 위해 마련한 강력하고 내실 있는 규칙.
entries.zh-Hans: 旨在对某项活动或行业实施实质性管控的有力且内容充实的规则。
entries.es: Normas firmes y de peso destinadas a ejercer un control efectivo sobre una actividad o un sector.
entries.pt-BR: Regras fortes e substanciais destinadas a exercer um controle efetivo sobre uma atividade ou um setor.
entries.fr: Règles fortes et substantielles destinées à exercer un contrôle effectif sur une activité ou un secteur.
entries.de: Starke, substanzielle Regeln, die dazu dienen sollen, eine Tätigkeit oder eine Branche wirksam zu kontrollieren.

entries.ja: 二つの政党の所属者が関わり、政党間の隔たりを越えた協力があることを示す。
entries.ko: 두 정당의 구성원들이 참여하며, 정당 간의 차이를 넘어 협력함을 나타내는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 有两个政党的成员参与，体现跨越党派分歧的合作。
entries.es: Que involucra a miembros de dos partidos políticos e indica cooperación por encima de las diferencias entre ambos.
entries.pt-BR: Que envolve integrantes de dois partidos políticos e indica cooperação apesar das diferenças partidárias.
entries.fr: Qui implique des membres de deux partis politiques et témoigne d’une coopération au-delà des divisions partisanes.
entries.de: Unter Beteiligung von Mitgliedern zweier politischer Parteien, was auf Zusammenarbeit über Parteigrenzen hinweg hinweist.

entries.ja: 反対を招く可能性のある意見も含め、自分の考えを公の場で率直に述べる。
entries.ko: 반대 의견을 불러올 수 있는 견해까지도 공개적으로 솔직하고 직접적으로 표현하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 公开而直率地表达观点，包括可能引起反对的观点。
entries.es: Que expresa sus opiniones de manera pública y directa, incluidas aquellas que pueden provocar desacuerdo.
entries.pt-BR: Que expressa opiniões publicamente e de forma direta, inclusive aquelas que podem provocar discordância.
entries.fr: Qui exprime ses opinions publiquement et directement, y compris celles qui peuvent susciter des désaccords.
entries.de: Die eigenen Ansichten öffentlich und unverblümt zum Ausdruck bringend, auch wenn diese Widerspruch hervorrufen können.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
